# Changelog

## 1.0.0

- Six areas for capture, life records, projects, reusable knowledge, planning, and templates.
- Four Templater layouts: NOTE, TASK, DAILY, and WEEKLY; optional dates/priorities and 24 thematic tags.
- Bases collection lists, event views, eight-column Kanban, four deadline lists, ISO journals, and drawings.
- Six bundled community plugins plus Second Brain Helpers.
- Automatic collection context, new-folder indices, inherited icons, and conservative task deletion with session Undo.
- README-first layout, Calendar/Kanban/Graph panels, bookmarks, workspaces, and area colors.

- Target validation: Windows desktop, Obsidian 1.14.4. macOS/Linux remain unvalidated; mobile is outside Helpers support.
- Essential workflows validated in an isolated Windows vault; targeted Helpers compatibility and failure-isolation checks completed.
